blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Semirara Mining and Power Corp. (SMPC) continued its tirade against the government coal bidding rules, saying that the planned auction would “kill” billions of pesos for no gain. “Why kill the golden goose for zero gain?” the company said in a statement on Monday. READ: Semirara cries foul over ‘unfair’ coal bidding rules Over its 29 years of operations, the Consunji-led group said it has paid P70.5 billion and contributed around P600 million annually to Caluya in Antique. Beyond government revenues, SMPC claimed its coal supply enables cheaper baseload power, with coal-fired facilities averaging P4.05 per kilowatt-hour (kWh) in […]...
